Players Committee card image of [[A New Secret Base (V) (ALT)]] (Alternate Image card; the PC card data has no entry for it yet).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/anewsecretbase_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/50d464c03a6e42edb650f994e0d31985ddd171c5 50d464c] (25 February 2024).

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
